context.Set<Laboratory>()
                .Include(l => l.Researchers)
                .Select(l => new Laboratory
                {
                    Id = l.Id,
                    Title = l.Title,
                    CreatedBy = l.CreatedBy,
                    CreatedOn = l.CreatedOn,
                    Researchers = l.Researchers,
                    ResearchersCount = l.Researchers != null ? l.Researchers.Count : 0,
                    Latitude = l.Latitude,
                    Longitude = l.Longitude,
                    Address = l.Address,
                    IsPublic = l.IsPublic
                })
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync

ctx.WaterDeficiencies.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(d => d.CreatedBy == userId)
            .Select(d => new ProfileJournalEntryDto
            {
                Id = d.Id,
                DeficiencyType = (int)EDeficiencyType.Water,
                Title = d.Title,
                CreatedOn = d.CreatedOn,
                Address = d.Address,
            })
            .ToListAsync

ctx.SoilDeficiencies.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(d => d.CreatedBy == userId)
            .Select(d => new ProfileJournalEntryDto
            {
                Id = d.Id,
                DeficiencyType = (int)EDeficiencyType.Soil,
                Title = d.Title,
                CreatedOn = d.CreatedOn,
                Address = d.Address,
            })
            .ToListAsync

context.Users
                .Where(u => u.Id == userId)
                .Select(u => new { u.PasswordResetToken, u.PasswordResetTokenExpiry })
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync
